title: Keep Network city autocomplete aligned with its current query
detail: Revalidated current main and merged backlog: SCAN-921 already repairs DirectorySearch cancellation; the distinct CircleLocationSearch on /network still published responses after its effect was aborted. A slow old city request overwrote the latest suggestions, clearing the input left loading true if the old request never settled, and provider/JSON rejection escaped the async timeout without stopping the spinner. Guard state publication and finalization with the effect abort signal, stop loading for short/empty input, and recover quietly from provider rejection consistently with the existing optional-suggestion contract. Three behavioral jsdom regressions failed on the old code (plus one unhandled rejection); after the fix 249 tests in 26 search/geocode/navigation suites passed and changed-file lint passed. The fourth regression preserves active filters and coordinate rounding when choosing a city. Mocked provider responses only; no external geocoding calls, geolocation prompts, production data changes, new dependencies, or token/style changes.

verify.note: Deferred responses that ignore abort cannot replace the latest city, short input stops loading without waiting for the old request, rejected provider work permits recovery, and selecting a city preserves current filters.
